messages:
Maya: spotted a repro where a workspace link can cause KMS key usage across orgs. 😬
Maya: steps: create workspace A in org alpha, create workspace B in org beta, create workspace-link from A->B, then call create-credential which returned kms_decrypt for key owned by alpha when running in beta.
Cal: wow — can you paste the minimal repro? logs?
Maya: pasted minimal curl and service log:
```
POST /v1/creds
{"source_workspace": "A", "target_workspace":"B"}
```
Maya: service log: `access_granted=true key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd principal=svc-workflow@beta` 
Priya: that sounds like the workspace-link code path is copying a principal mapping without scoping the KMS binding. probable bug in project_mappings.apply()
Eli: adding :rotating_light: tagging — I think this is similar to an earlier propagation bug but not identical. Can someone run an audit query for KMS grants in last 24h?
Priya: running query now: `select * from audit.events where action=\'kms:Decrypt\' and resource like \'%key/abcd%\'` returns three events from beta-runner with workspace_id=B and org_id=beta but principal_org=alpha
Maya: reproduction attached: repo link https://stash.redwood.internal/projects/INF/repos/ws-link-repro/browse
Cal: short-term mitigation: revoke cross-org default grant in KMS binding service and disable automatic link propagation. ops-bot, can you push a config flip?
ops-bot: deploy started for config: disable_workspace_link_propagation => true
ops-bot: deploy success — 2 instances rolled, 3 pending
Eli: can we add an alert for mismatched principal_org vs resource_org for KMS events? create a detection rule in sec-sig
Priya: filed detection rule #SEC-412: "kms-principal-org-mismatch" — added query and a runbook
Maya: patch branch open: https://github.com/redwood/infra/commit/def456 — fixes apply() to scope grants. needs review.
Cal: will review now, please include unit test and an integration test that runs the repro
Eli: also need to backfill audit logs to identify customers impacted. security-bot, kick off backfill job?
security-bot: backfill job queued (id=bf-2026-03-20-01). ETA 2h
Maya: timeline: hotfix + config flip done. follow-ups: postmortem + customer outreach if backfill finds external tenants. I'll own postmortem.
Cal: thanks. tagging Priya for compliance signoff and Eli for forensics
Priya: will coordinate. adding compliance template to doc.
Maya: thanks all. will update in this thread when backfill completes. :thumbsup:
